o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *el, *elig. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰀𐰠𐰃𐰏 (älig, “hand”), Turkish el, Chuvash алӑ (ală).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish پوخ (poḫ), from Proto-Turkic *bok (“dirt, dung”). Cognate with Turkish bok, Salar boq, Chuvash пӑх (păh) etc.

Etymology tree
Akkadian 𒁇 (ṣalāpu)bor.
Aramaic צְלִיבָא (ṣəlīḇā)bor.
Arabic صَلِيب (ṣalīb)bor.
Azerbaijani səlib
Borrowed from Arabic صَلِيب (ṣalīb).
Probably a derivation of Proto-Turkic *sač- (“to scatter, spatter, sow”), whence also saçmaq.
